newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Avenor to sell Pacific Forest stake.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Avenor to sell Pacific Forest stake.

text.p: Canadian pulp and paper maker Avenor Inc. said on Wednesday that it agreed to sell its 53 percent stake in Pacific Forest Products Ltd. for about C$573 million ($418 million).
Under the deal, a unit of TimberWest Timber Trust will acquire Avenor's stake in Pacific Forest for C$29 ($21.17) a share cash.

A unit of Doman Industries Ltd. will then buy Pacific Forest's three sawmills, woodland tenures and related operations from TimberWest for about C$144 million ($105 million), including a proportionate amount of working capital.
Avenor is based in Montreal, while Pacific Forest, TimberWest and Doman are based in British Columbia.
Definitive agreements on the transactions were to be signed by July 30, while the actual deals were expected to be completed by autumn, the companies said.
In Toronto Stock Exchange trading on Wednesday, Avenor shares rose C10 cents to C$28.80, while Pacific Forest was up C45 cents to C$28.35. Doman class B shares were down C25 cents to C$9.
